title: The Before · Fieldwork
dek: Early naturalists and later researchers leave observations and warnings for those who return to the ruins.
body:
The Before is a ruined city overtaken by mountain and forest, with streets and buildings reclaimed by moss, ivy and trees. It had already been stripped and looted before the present explorers arrived. Its original name, builders and the cause of its fall remain outside this public fieldwork history.

Scene evidence: 1.

March 2024 · two ways of taking notes

Scribonia seeks Jako’s experience with natural environments before exploring the ruins. Jako agrees that traveling together offers mutual protection. Along the way, Scribonia catalogs plants and animals and gathers samples; Jako records them in drawings. They exchange explanations of words and childhood customs. Patient observation and teaching accompany the expedition’s combat and search for treasure.

Scene evidence: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

September 2026 · old notes guide a new expedition

Minerva briefs later explorers to move quietly, watch for aberrations and avoid entering or casting inside the haze. She explicitly cites Scribonia’s notes for the warning that it feeds on spells. She asks the group to report historically interesting finds to her. The briefing establishes inherited precautions and an ongoing research interest; it does not resolve the ruins’ origins or independently prove every hazard rule she repeats.

Scene evidence: 1.

The peace-agreement survey records another expedition and its discoveries. Later quest accounts preserve further visits without making the whole site safe or fully understood.
